purpose: Hand-off briefing for next AI agent
scope_note: This recap summarizes the major ideas, lore, and technical directions discussed across the conversation. It condenses long dialogue into structured canonical information so another agent can continue work without reading the entire chat.

universe.name: Slayverse
universe.core_concept: A fictional cosmology blending drag aesthetics, cosmic mythology, archival storytelling, and sci‑fi metaphysics. The universe combines theatrical glamour with structured mythological canon.

GWIG.name: Golden Wings Intergalactic Guild
GWIG.description: A guild-like interstellar organization preserving knowledge, lore, and ritual performance across the Slayverse.

The_Weaver.description: An entity who observes destiny and the cosmic threads that connect beings across time. Does not interfere but reveals truth when necessary.

Professor_Von_Hooplehopper.description: A key scholar figure within the Slayverse mythos, connected to hidden family history and cosmic anomalies.

Miss_Slaytonia_VUORSE.description: A digital or metaphysical persona emerging from the Slayton field. Associated with future codex volumes and cosmic summits.

Jake_McCullen.description: A hardened rancher tied unknowingly to cosmic events involving a shard of time and the Federstahl lineage.

Pop.description: A man driven mad by interaction with a cosmic shard linked to the Slayton lattice fracture.

cosmic_physics.Slayton_Field: A metaphysical field representing identity resonance and narrative energy.
cosmic_physics.glamorons: Hypothetical particles representing bursts of glamour or identity energy.
cosmic_physics.Slay_Mode: A state of maximum personal resonance and expression within the Slayton field.
cosmic_physics.Velvet_Singularity: The theoretical point where the Slayton field reaches maximum narrative density.

codex.name: Slayton Codex
codex.description: A canonical archive documenting major cosmic events and phenomena within the Slayverse.

western_layer_storyline.central_conflict: A cosmic shard embedded in the land creates madness and hidden history within Jake's family line.
